name: Trial expired
description: Sent the day a trial lapses: what state the account is in now, how long the data is kept, and how to pick it back up.

origin.note: Design: quiet graphite — no accent colour, generous margins, the two load-bearing facts given their own weight.

subject: Your {{ product.name }} trial has ended
preheader: Your workspace is read-only. Everything in it is still there.

retention_days.description: How long the data is kept before deletion. A real number, honoured by the system that sends this.

deletion_date.description: The date the data actually goes. A date is harder to misread than a countdown, and this is the fact people come back to the email for.

current_state.description: Plain description of what still works and what does not.
current_state.default: Your workspace is read-only. You can still open, export and share everything in it, but new sends are paused.

action_url.description: Where to restart on a paid plan.

button_label.default: Pick up where you left off

export_url.description: Link to export their data. Offering the exit honestly is what makes the rest believable.
